description: The neutral internal categories every catalogue maps into. This file cites no publisher: the category names are this project's own, and it is the only place a registry vocabulary and a catalogue vocabulary are allowed to meet. Each side maps its own labels into these names independently, so no vocabulary file has to name the other side's values. A label neither side maps yields no category and compares as unknown. A category only one side produces is a supported state rather than a gap: it is declared per category in produced_by, and a comparison against it returns unknown, which earns no points and vetoes nothing.

drive.description: Internal drive category. Read by the candidate drive comparison and the VIN drive comparison, so the two can never drift apart.

fuel.description: Internal fuel category, compared between a source row's fuel field and a candidate's fuel field.

petrol_hybrid.note: Plug-in and non-plug-in hybrids share one category because the reference vocabulary does not separate them; a reference listing both would tie and go to review rather than pick one.

diesel_hybrid.note: Plug-in and non-plug-in hybrids share one category because the reference vocabulary does not separate them; a reference listing both would tie and go to review rather than pick one.

lpg.one_sided_note: LPG and CNG are their own categories, distinct from the reference's combined Petrol/LPG, so the two disagree rather than falsely agreeing.

cng.one_sided_note: LPG and CNG are their own categories, distinct from the reference's combined Petrol/LPG, so the two disagree rather than falsely agreeing.

petrol_lpg.one_sided_note: LPG and CNG are their own categories, distinct from the reference's combined Petrol/LPG, so the two disagree rather than falsely agreeing.

fuel_family.description: The fuel family a free-text submodel reading can corroborate, paired with a hybrid flag. Narrower than the fuel axis on purpose: this only has to answer 'does the SUBMODEL text contradict the fuel field', so gas blends have no entry.

body.description: Internal body category, compared between a source row's body field and a candidate's structure field. A category exists only where both publishers print the same name for the structure, which is the only pairing the registry and catalogue sides record.

cab.description: Internal cab configuration category. Registry-only by nature: the reference extract carries no cab column, so nothing on the catalogue side produces one and no comparison reads it.

single.one_sided_note: Cab wording observed in SUBMODEL free text and recorded for the audit trail only. No correspondence with any reference structure is asserted.
